scope: 工作流依赖整包导入导出
Electron 宿主打开本地目录

productionEvidence.localWorkflows: 真实工作区文件、原子替换、活动目录持久化、自愈设置保留、导入导出和路径防穿越
productionEvidence.imageAssets: 真实图片字节、持久索引、目录树、移动、改名、递归删除、受控文件读取和工作区边界校验
productionEvidence.workflowBundles: 工作流、自定义模块闭包和被引用图片字节打包；导入时恢复资源并重映射模块引用
productionEvidence.openFolder: 后端只解析真实目录，renderer 通过受控 studio-platform open_path IPC 打开

checks.command: uv run pytest tests/contract/test_local_workflows.py tests/contract/test_image_assets.py tests/contract/test_workflow_bundle.py tests/contract/test_studio_image_schemas.py tests/contract/test_custom_modules_api.py -q
npm test -- --run local-workflow-protection image-panel-loading image-asset-preview toolbar-draft-protection document-export-entry
uv run ruff check <P1 changed Python files> && uv run mypy <P1 service and adapter files>
npm run openapi:check && npm run typecheck

remaining: 正式 Electron 本地模式“打开位置”宿主动作验收
macOS Intel 与 Windows 实测
